name: nemor-cards
description: Nemor Cards (Карточки) — a Quizlet analog: Expo web/native client + Cloudflare Worker BFF on D1.

scripts.install:all: cd app && npm install && cd ../worker && npm install
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && cd worker && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:init: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute nemor-cards --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute nemor-cards --remote --file=./schema.sql
